_notes.placement: section = a 'Level up' section after the stats; inline = each tip follows the stat it cites; both = inline pairs where a cite exists, section for the rest
_notes.slides: [min, max] rotating slides per pack; anchors (cold open, big number, archetype, outro) are extra
_notes.anchors_from: which pack supplies the anchor slides; if that pack is disabled, the composer builds a short cold open + outro from what's left
_notes.profile: default-12 = 8 stats slides (anchors included) + 4 coaching slides, each coaching slide right after the stat it cites; same slot plan as the Agent Retro plugin (agent-retro/plugins/agent-retro/reference/deck-spec.md). Set profile to "custom" to use the slide ranges freely.
